name: Sicile Gloria
source:
Sicile is one of Michelle's daughters. Even though she is only 17, she acts like everyone's mother.

Even though she is part of the family, she serves the household as a maid, as some form of punishment. Her docile nature makes it hard to imagine what she did to get such a punishment.
